Chapter 6796: Don’T Be Impatient

Chapter 6796: Don’t Be Impatient

Li Qiye’s mere glance crushed the apocalyptic attacks.

“This is Epoch Dawn, enough of your impudence!” An immortal shouted.

Epoch Dawn was one of the nine major worlds - the home to Heaven Assault Alliance.

“Impudence?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Let’s see who you are!” The figures activated their dreadful immortal energy, affecting all of Heavenrealm.

After Heaven Pit, Heaven Assault became the strongest alliance. In this world alone, they had five primordial immortals, not to mention numerous grand and golden immortals.

“Brothers, don’t be impatient. Isn’t it a joy to have a friend visiting from afar? Allow me to welcome him.” A voice came from the depths of this world.

A majestic palace emerged, garnering everyone’s attention.

This world had layers of firmaments and countless domains. All rotated around this palace. The immortals bowed and agreed.

“Friend, would you like to visit my humble abode?” The voice from the palace spoke.

“Crawl out here.” Li Qiye smiled and exerted his supreme will on the palace.

“Boom!” Flames erupted around the palace, sealing all affinities.

The will still crushed the flames, causing cracks to appear around the palace.

“Stop!” The spectating immortals became alarmed.

“It’s fine, brothers, let me speak with him.” An immortal left the palace.

The others stared at Li Qiye in confusion before leaving.

This immortal possessed the proper bearing of this cultivation realm. He radiated transcendence and effortless grace. Overlords couldn’t imitate such a natural poise.

He was clad in a feathered robe. His light seemed to bless this world, carrying both energy and life force. His very being prospered others.

Thus, living beings couldn’t help but look up at him - the founder and embodiment of hope.

“I am Sheng Shengxian. May I ask for your name?” He bowed.

After Heaven Pit, Dusk fell in battle. Heavenfall disappeared and even the lord of Heaven Assault Alliance, Genesis, went missing.

Since the shored immortals were gone, the primordial immortals became the strongest. Among them were Sheng Shengxian and Golden Law.

Many said Golden Law had reached the shore and became a celestial immortal. However, his lifespan ran weak.

As for Sheng Shengxian, he was young and full of life, capable of reaching the shore. Moreover, he had a special legacy - a world tree.

Li Qiye let go of the woman and said: “Li Qiye.”

“Li Qiye? One fewer night than Li Baye?” Sheng Shengxian’s expression changed: “You are similar to another mighty cultivator.”

“Is that so?” Li Qiye smirked.

“Everyone knows Brother Li Baye in Heavenrealm. They call him the Enlightener or Eternal Sacred Teacher.” Sheng Shengxian said.

Only a few immortals remembered his name, Li Baye. Everyone else called him by his title.

His achievement surpassed all immortals. After all, after the breaking of the dao, he poured primordial chaos energy and laws to Heavenrealm again.

Cultivators, wallowing in despair, regained their power. Therefore, they all worshipped him in reverence.

This frustrated Li Baye since he only wanted to be known as someone having one more night than Li Qiye.
